newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistani stocks end up, seen rising on IMF talks.
newsitem.headline: Pakistani stocks end up, seen rising on IMF talks.

text.p: Pakistani stocks closed up on Sunday and are likely to open higher on Monday after a government delegation left for Washington for talks with the International Monetary Fund, dealers said.
The delegation is likely to seek IMF's support on Pakistan's latest proposals to rescue the economy.

The Karachi Stock Exchange (KSE) 100-share index rose 11.41 points, or 0.84 percent, to end at 1,375.80 amid covering of short positions. Losers led gainers 130 to 112. Turnover fell to 16.72 million shares from 17.26 million in the previous session on Thursday.
